description_en: Removes nodes from a node pool in a cluster and adjusts the expected number of nodes. When removing nodes, you can specify whether to release the associated ECS instances and whether to drain the nodes. Removing nodes involves pod migration, which may affect your services. Perform this operation during off-peak hours and back up your data in advance
description_zh: 当您不再需要集群节点继续工作时，可以调用RemoveNodePoolNodes接口将集群中的节点移出节点池，并同时调整期望节点数。移除节点时，您可以选择是否同时释放ECS、是否自动排空节点。移除节点会涉及Pod迁移，可能会影响业务，请在业务低峰期操作并提前做好相关的数据备份
kebab_example: aliyun cs remove-node-pool-nodes --cluster-id c23421cfa74454bc8b37163fd19af0000 --nodepool-id np97de2cfb1ba042398dd8f5504c940000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveNodePoolNodes

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to release the nodes. Valid values:
true: Release the nodes.
false: Do not release the nodes
parameters.help_zh:
是否释放节点。可选值：
true：释放。
false：不释放
parameters.name: release_node

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to drain the nodes. Valid values:
true: Drain the nodes.
false: Do not drain the nodes
parameters.help_zh:
是否排水节点。可选值：
true：排水。
false：不排水
parameters.name: drain_node

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove nodes concurrently.

true: Nodes are concurrently removed from the scaling group.

false: Nodes are sequentially removed from the scaling group.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否并发移除。

true：节点将并发从伸缩组中被移除。

false：节点将顺序从伸缩组中被移除。

默认值：false
parameters.name: concurrency
